entities.name: Bifunctional CoaBC
observations: The 418-residue query has 47% identity and about 97% coverage to reviewed bacterial CoaBC proteins.
The N-terminal region matches phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylase; the C-terminal region matches phosphopantothenate--cysteine ligase.
The query contains Pfam Flavoprotein PF02441 at positions 5-185 and DFP PF04127 at positions 202-410.
Close reviewed homologs bind FMN and require Mg2+.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+.
This is EC 6.3.2.5 and Rhea RHEA:19397 in close reviewed CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: This is EC 4.1.1.36 and Rhea RHEA:16793 in close reviewed CoaBC homologs.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs the second and third enzymatic steps of bacterial CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
